_readme: THE HAULOVER GATE AT DUSK -- the same playable scene, with the Earth turned further round the light:
the sun has set at the Merrimack (-2.04 deg) and is still up at Haulover (+16.40 deg). Drive into
the gate and you come out of the dusk into daylight; the window inside that window is this inlet
again, at dusk, and so on down the corridor. Each world asks its own planet whether it has a sun,
so the near sea shows no glint while Haulover's sea keeps its own.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/haulover_dusk.json
Controls are haulover_portal.json's. The sun sets behind the boat (azimuth 213.7): steer round,
or press T and look back. sun.earth.spin is a RESTART key; 107.0777 is the original sunset.
